description: Something ruled out. Must not be reported as agreed, and no date may be invented.

segments.text: Are we exchanging this week? My landlord needs notice.
No, I'm afraid we won't be exchanging this week. The buyer in the chain above is still waiting for their mortgage valuation.
That's frustrating. Do you know when it might be?
I can't give you a date yet. I'll speak to the other side's solicitors tomorrow and update you straight after.
Okay. I'll hold off giving notice then.
